title: delta* gap H(rho)/(beta log n) IS the entropy-rate of the census numerator: ceiling distance to capacity = (log2 I_inf)/(beta log2 n) via method-of-types
wall: W-Johnson (the entropy-gate ceiling lands ABOVE the Johnson radius 1-sqrt(rho) at every prize-shaped q~n^beta; the prize window interior is untouched)
evidence: Two separable sub-claims. (A) STRUCTURAL HALF -- PROVEN and correct. Both cited in-tree facts are real, sorry-free, axiom-clean (grep: 0 sorry/admit/native_decide in EntropyGateDeltaStar.lean, KKH26EntropyForm.lean, KKH26AsymptoticCeiling.lean; the one grep hit in the latter is the #print-axioms comment). (i) kkh26_gap_identity proves the [KKH26] ceiling sits EXACTLY gap=(2m-1)/n below capacity 1-rho, and kkh26_gap_bracket proves (2m-1)/n in [1/2^mu, 2/2^mu) = Theta(1/2^mu) (subgroup-SIZE). (ii) KKH26EntropyForm.choose_ge_two_rpow_entropy_div proves C(s,r) >= 2^{s*H2(r/s)}/(s+1) by a genuine pure-Nat method-of-types mode argument (pow_self_le_succ_mul_choose), so log2 I_inf ~ s*H2(rho). These two are a real, elegant in-tree result and the 'entropy-rate of the census numerator' framing is literally correct. mcaDeltaStar_le_of_ceiling_window (DeepBandCeilingWindow.lean) is an HONEST combinatorial UPPER bracket (bad-witness count crossing q^{m+1}), not a fabricated closure. (B) THE HEADLINE WELD -- REFUTED in the prize regime. Claim 3 ('pin fires when I_inf~n, solving gives gap=H(rho)/(beta log n)') and the attack_plan's promise (discharge the two entropy-gate walls => 'upper-bracket ceiling for the GENERIC ladder code unconditionally, a real advance on the upper side') both fail at prize scale. Two exact-integer probes: (1) scripts/probes/_407_conn/C030_gap_vs_entropy_rate.py -- the PROVEN gap (2m-1)/n=Theta(1/2^mu) and the CLAIMED gap H(rho)/(beta log2 n) are DIFFERENT functions: proven ~ 1/2^mu (subgroup-size, EXPONENTIALLY small in mu), claimed ~ H(rho)/(beta*mu) at m=1 (only POLYNOMIALLY small in mu). claim/proven ratio = 0.43 (mu=3), 1.04 (mu=5), 16.6 (mu=10), 8.5e3 (mu=20), 5.8e6 (mu=30). They coincide ONLY when 2^mu ~ C*log n, which is EXACTLY the separate regime hypothesis of kkh26_gap_ge_of_mu_le_log (2^mu <= C*log2 n = a SMALL/logarithmic subgroup), the OPPOSITE of the thin prize subgroup. (2) scripts/probes/_407_conn/C030_entropy_gate_prize.py -- run mcaDeltaStar_le_of_entropy_gate's two walls (a!*2*q^m <= (n+1-a)^a ; n^a < a!*q^{m+1}, a=k+m+1) at q~n^beta, beta in {4,5}: in EVERY prize-shaped row the resulting delta=1-a/n lands ABOVE the Johnson radius 1-sqrt(rho) (inWindow?=False everywhere, n=16,32,64, all rho in {1/2,1/4,1/8,1/16}). Closed-form reason: both walls together force k+1 >= (beta-1)m AND k < (beta-1)(m+1), a width-(beta-1) k-band centered at k~(beta-1)m, so rho~(beta-1)m/n; hitting prize rho=1/4 forces m=Theta(n) and hence the subgroup 2^mu=n/m=Theta(1) (~12-20), NOT 2^30. So the gate is non-vacuous only for O(1)-sized subgroups, where there is no BGK obstruction and no prize-window advance.
honest_note: PARTIAL not REFUTED because the structural identification (gap = exact (2m-1)/n; census numerator log2 = s*H2(rho) by method-of-types; both axiom-clean in-tree) is genuinely true and a nice piece of intuition for WHY an H(rho)/log-style constant appears. What is refuted is only the prize-regime force of the weld: (a) the gap-FORM equality (2m-1)/n = H(rho)/(beta log n) holds only in the 2^mu<=C log n small-subgroup regime (kkh26_gap_ge_of_mu_le_log's own hypothesis), not the thin prize subgroup; (b) the attack_plan's 'unconditional upper-bracket advance' is vacuous at prize q~n^beta -- the entropy gate's two walls are simultaneously satisfiable only when 2^mu=O(1), and even then yield delta ABOVE Johnson (1-a/n > 1-sqrt(rho)), so it never enters the prize window (1-sqrt(rho), 1-rho-Theta(1/log n)). This matches DISPROOF_LOG L1763-1770: the BELIEVED form is 1-rho-Theta(H(rho)/(log2|F|-128-log2 n)) and the open core 'prove ell(theta)<=2^{O(H(rho)/eta)}' stays open; C030 re-expresses the heuristic numerator H(rho) as a census entropy rate but adds no prize-regime bound. I did NOT run a full lake build of the substrate (DeepBandCeilingWindow.olean is not pre-built on this machine and building it takes the shared lock); the cited theorems are already landed in-tree with their own #print axioms directives and are grep-confirmed sorry-free, so their correctness is not in question -- my attack targets the connection's interpretive claim, which the two exact integer probes settle. No new DISPROOF_LOG entry strictly required (no in-tree theorem is falsified); a one-line note 'C030 entropy-gate fires only for 2^mu=O(1), delta lands above Johnson, vacuous at prize; gap-form match needs 2^mu<=C log n, opposite of prize' would be appropriate.
